data.name: Ecstatica II
data.detailed_description:
RESCUE ECSTATICA

Welcome to a world of magic, mysterious traps and diabolical danger, graphical glory and fast, fiendish gameplay. Your desperate struggle against the forces of chaos will pit you against a relentless enemy onslaught; you'll need wits, cunning and expert swordsmanship to defeat the evil nemeses. Let's hope you don't pass out at the sight of blood. 

Using unique Ellipsoid technology, Ecstatica II places you in a vast gaming world that'll keep you in its spell for a long, long time. With over 1100 camera views, superbly animated characters and a huge array of magic weapons, this is an exceptional action adventure from one of the most creative teams around.

WHAT’S INSIDE THIS RELEASE

First released in 1997, Ecstatica II built on its cult predecessor with a far larger world, deeper combat and over 1,100 hand-chosen cinematic camera angles, all rendered in Andrew Spencer's unmistakable ellipsoid style. Now this lost gem of late-'90s PC action-adventure is available digitally for the first time.

The re-released version not only ensures that the game runs smoothly on modern systems, but also adds a number of improvements, including full controller support and the ability to switch between three graphics modes, from Classic DOS to Software mode with modern resolutions.

FEATURES

  • Three graphics modes: Classic DOS, Classic Windows and Software with modern resolutions

  • Full controller support

  • Incredible landscapes with hundreds of rooms to explore, mysterious puzzles and vicious hand-to-hand combat

  • Your impressive armory includes 8 deadly weapons and 2 mysterious wands

  • With over 60 different breeds of creature baying for your blood, this game packs all the dark, brooding atmosphere of approaching evil

  • Gorgeously animated ellipsoid characters

data.short_description: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.
data.supported_languages:
English*, French, German
*languages with full audio support

Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: 1.8 GHz
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 9.0c Compatible Graphics Card
  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible

content_descriptors.notes: Ecstatica II is a game developed in 1997. According to official ratings from that time, it contains animated violence, blood, and gore. Might not be appropriate for all audiences.
